attempts: Official Bishoftu city page was discovered and reviewed; it lists a local Land Office. Direct curl from this host failed DNS resolution for www.bishoftu.gov.et, while the search result supplied the first-party page; no bypass was attempted.
Official e-Land viewer and api.config.json were fetched anonymously; the configuration exposed the WFS endpoint and Addis-oriented client/API configuration.
Anonymous e-Land app-location request for cityCode OR-BIS returned HTTP 401; no login, credentials, or token was used.
Anonymous WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and advertised v_1_registered_parcel, v_1_parcel_cadaster_publish, EPSG:20137, and other layers.
Anonymous DescribeFeatureType for v_1_parcel_cadaster_publish returned HTTP 200, identifying MultiPolygon geometry and candidate safe fields id and uniqueparcelid.

Bounded WFS GetFeature requests for both registered-parcel and parcel-publish layers around exact WUP point [8.75862197493687, 38.9583814728029] returned HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollections. No hit/miss or citywide-absence inference was made.
Official Ethio-NSDI Bishoftu addressing publication and Oromia Bishoftu planning material were reviewed as contextual sources; neither supplied a public parcel-vector response.
No login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address/titleholder field, or TLS-verification exception was used.
